[[File:Cryoban_Grenade.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Two victims of a [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan grenade]].]]
{{Quote|Got word House Thul is smuggling in CryoBan weapons. Very illegal. Freeze you in three seconds flat.|Aza Gundo|<ref name="TORFA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Frozen Assets|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
'''CryoBan''', also stylized '''Cryoban''',<ref name="ROTHC">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=general|A Spy's Secret/An Emerging Dread|Belsavis}}</ref> was a chemical agent that absorbed heat quickly, creating intense cold at the point of detonation.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The agent was originally developed as a fire suppressant,<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and it broke down quickly, releasing the heat back into the environment.<ref name="MB">[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|''Star Wars Miniatures Battles'', First Edition]]</ref> 

Organic beings exposed to CryoBan experienced numbing cold,<ref name="EGWT" /> which stunned them and caused severe nerve and cellular damage to any exposed skin.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The areas could be treated with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], but unless it was immediately applied, the individual was likely to lose a limb or suffer nerve damage.<ref name="EGWT" /> 

CryoBan was also effective at destroying electronics, vehicles, and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] if they were not sufficiently adapted to operate in cold-weather environments.<ref name="EGWT" />

Weapons technology using CryoBan used elements adapted from the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-freezing]] process to freeze targets. Weapons made using this technology included [[CryoBan rifle/Legends|CryoBan rifles]], [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan grenades]] and [[CryoBan cell]]s.
